reader.requirement: Every execution of REWRITE on a relative file must update its I-O status (FILE STATUS item) with the VIII.1.3.4 value for the outcome: 00 success, 23 absent record, 43 no preceding successful READ in sequential access, 44 outside the RECORD VARYING bounds, 49 file not open in the I-O mode (not open, INPUT, OUTPUT, EXTEND, after a failed OPEN).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (from 2002): at 85 only a RECORD IS VARYING clause bounds the REWRITE size (44); a RECORD CONTAINS range does not
FileSharingFacility off at 85; status assignment unchanged

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior over the REWRITE path files; the status values come from FileStatusCode constants shared by every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: for the statuses this rule reaches, 2023 prints the same values (the RECORD CONTAINS range arm is GR12's, not exercised here)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf26_03 covers 00, 23 and 49 (open INPUT); not 43, 44, 49 for not open/OUTPUT/EXTEND/after a failed OPEN

probes.printed: USE 49 NOTOPEN 49 / USE 49 OUTPUT 49 / USE 49 EXTEND 49 / USE 49 INPUT 49 / READ1 00 06 / USE 44 SHORT 44 / USE 43 AFTER-FAIL 43 / READ2 00 08 / MAXLEN 00 / USE-N 35 OPEN-N 35 / USE-N 49 AFTER-FAILED-OPEN 49
probes.expected: the FILE STATUS item (planted 99 before each) changes to 49, 49, 49, 49, 44, 43, 00, and 49 after a failed OPEN; USE procedure runs for each unsuccessful one

probes.printed: K3 INV 23 / K0 INV 23 / K9999 INV 23 / K2D INV 23 / K5F INV 23 / K4F OK 00 / K14 OK 00

reader.notes: The emitter writes the connector status into the FILE STATUS item after every REWRITE (EmitStoreFileStatus) before the USE hook and the INVALID KEY dispatch. rw8a at --std 2023 prints the identical lines.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-136/g8b.cob at --std 85 (runs/g8b-001), RANDOM access, RECORD IS VARYING 4 TO 12 DEPENDING ON RA-LEN, '99' planted before each REWRITE: RA-LEN 13 -> 'USE 44 / LONG 44'; RA-LEN 3 -> 'USE 44 / SHORT 44' (INVALID KEY not taken, VIII.1.3.4 5d1); absent key -> 'ABS INV 23' (status set before the imperative); success -> 'OK NOT 00'; CLOSE WITH LOCK then REWRITE -> 'USE 49 / AFTER-LOCK 49' (a not-open state the reader did not try); OPEN after lock -> 38. Every outcome updates the FILE STATUS item with the VIII.1.3.4 value. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR8  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.4  (1.3.4 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.5c'.
